target_customer: Organizers of online conferences and events
problem: Online events were passive; attendees wanted real networking.

founders.name: Marc Metz
previous_startups: Party Like Gatsby (co-founder, themed parties; per Daily case study)

competitors.name: Hopin
competitors.what: Virtual events platform with networking features
competitors.traction_then: Attendees grew from 16,000 in March to 175,000 in June 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time video, maps and matching built on Daily's API.

defensibility.rationale: Well funded rivals with similar features; video built on third party APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hopin raised billions in valuation and events moved back in person after 2021.

market_need_then: Pandemic forced events online in 2020; Hopin's rapid growth showed demand.

branding.domain_note: meetanyway.com; did not resolve from the fetch environment

outcome_analysis: MeetAnyway sold networking focused online events and got hosts such as BMW and Tel Aviv University, but it competed with Hopin and other well funded platforms. Demand for pure online events collapsed as in person events returned from late 2021 onward, and the company is inactive. The cause is not stated by the founders, so the failure factors are inferred from the market shift.
